name: remote-mobile-transport
goal: The simulator app pairs, reads, caches, reconnects and is revoked through the real Swift plugin against the backend test fixture; approvals name the displayed identity; UI states are recorded as source-bound evidence

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Third-pass scope: RemoteApprovalInput.deviceId from the displayed request; evidence captures remote-screens-mobile and remote-screens-desktop for the nine states of scenario remote-mobile-ui; cache budget enforced on every write in copies and bytes; real native transport in the simulator against the backend TEST ONLY fixture with Debug-only loopback, Release refusing; system link prompt needs a tap by root.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: RemoteApproval sends deviceId and both screens show the whole identity; remote-evidence.ts with recordCapture and buildStamp; RemoteCacheIndex with least-recently-used eviction and RemoteCacheBudget; changes carry epoch; refusals end waiting reads; fixture statement in the native status only in Debug with -HarnessRemoteLoopback; build script --fixture (ad hoc signed, local networking and inspection in the built product only) and --release; safe-area strip while scrolling and wrapping status bar.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: Native acceptance on final builds through the real web view, 28 checks passed: pairing 9, workspace/lock/saved copies after relaunch/reconnect/revocation 15, Release refusal 4. bun run ios:check:native Debug 136 and Release 120 passed; mutation 21 of 22; vectors reproduced. E2E whole suite 37 passed; evidence run on the stamped build 12 passed with 9 captures. Unit 305 passed, 7 skipped; two backend files fail at import with an esbuild service error (remote-fixture-script, remote-relay-workerd). Reviewer files untouched: ios-cache-authority 8ad942d4f854, remote-authority-races 04449490473c. Screenshots inspected, none committed.
